description: Creates a response using the OpenAI Responses API request shape. The model details must advertise the Responses request format and the model must be available. Unknown fields are accepted on a best-effort basis; model-specific support is not guaranteed.

Idempotency-Key.description: Optional key that stops a second run of the same request. Send a new unique value, such as a UUID, …

X-TokenLab-Delivery-Policy.description: Per-request Delivery policy. Overrides the API key and Workspace defaults. Auto tries TokenLab Veri…

background.description: Whether to run the response asynchronously.

include.description: Additional response sections to include when supported.

oneOf.description: Structured input items for the conversation.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may issue parallel tool calls.

previous_response_id.description: ID of a previous response to continue.

service_tier.description: Standard tier pricing; auto/default forwarded; flex/priority/fast/ultrafast ignored.

store.description: Whether the response is stored for later retrieval.

include_obfuscation.description: When true, request obfuscated tokens in Responses stream events where supported.

tool_choice.description: Tool choice policy or explicit tool selection.

tools.description: Tools; allowed types/combinations depend on the selected service.
